defaults.setup: Build the once-created exact candidate and inspect its npm tarballs, skills/contracts archives, manifest, checksums, SBOM, licenses, and dependency graph.
defaults.action: Run package and architecture gates against extracted candidate bytes without workspace imports.

rows.oracle: Tarballs expose exact root exports/bins, dependency direction, and no deep-import or third-party core compatibility claim.
Candidate inventory contains exact-version package tarballs, skills/contracts zip+tar, release manifest, SHA256SUMS, and SBOM.
All packages enforce Node ^24.0.0 ESM and every platform artifact contains no native addon, bundled runtime, browser, or install build.
Installed exact-version CLI operates an ordinary directory with none of the forbidden project metadata or services.
CLI/MCP tarballs contain shrinkwraps and explicit files, no lifecycle install scripts, and exact allowed dependency graphs.
Pinned installer and checksummed fallback copy immutable bytes only after approval and setup never bootstraps itself.
Every package, skill, contract, doc, evidence item, and manifest reports one exact full release version.
Version-policy fixtures classify patch, minor, and major changes exactly and reject incompatible contract drift on lower releases.
Compatibility gates inspect prior disk families and current/prior protocol families with the required migration and notice boundaries.
Stable/prerelease channels and release flags match policy while every public install reference pins exact SemVer.
Signed protected tag, clean once-built artifacts, immutable release, attestations, OIDC provenance, signatures, and checksums verify.
License-map inspection includes only local corpus paths and explicitly excludes hosted root/assets, brand, user content, and third-party works.
Every independent artifact contains its exact complete license/notices and copied-license inventory based on final bytes.
Human gate records DCO, CLA policy, AI provenance review, authority/scope control, audits, scans, and final inventory approval.
Actual tarballs/archives satisfy every indexed version, dependency, engine, export, byte, license, secret, SBOM, checksum, and attestation check.
Every maintained tuple runs the applicable suite against exact candidate digests and retains the full platform identity and corpus revision.
Stable publication accepts only an attested exact deferred empty support index or a fully qualified passing set and rejects missing, mismatched, or false Supported Host claims.

Pre-tag and publication gates enforce one current-main qualification, an exact GitHub-authenticated sole-maintainer plan approval, keyless workflow-bound tag signing, exact no-bypass repository controls, GitHub-hosted runners, npm OIDC subject, and retained sanitized evidence without claiming independent review.

The exact 1.0.0 bootstrap is limited to one least-privilege short-lived credential and cannot finalize a GitHub Release; finalization proves exact public bytes, the attested bootstrap, credential removal, disabled token publication, and all three exact OIDC trust records without republishing npm; later versions are OIDC-only.

The durable operation adopts prior attempts, permits only a conclusive reviewed successor, correlates the one returned child run ID through delayed metadata, stops at public or ambiguous state, restores the sole tag policy on every exit path, and exercises the shared gates without secrets or publication under a minimal tool set.
